notes:
Features and improvements through version 1.0.14:

COURSES AND ANALYSIS
• Desktop interface for selecting DVH files, entering fractionation and specifying course gaps.
• Responsive course layout with column wrapping and scrolling when needed.
• Patient name read from the last course’s DVH file.
• Input review, calculation progress and diagnostic error logs.

PHYSICISTS AND BRANDING
• Searchable physicist dropdown with locally saved additions and removals.
• Yenzakahle logo, consistent window icons and yellow-accented interface.
• Help window with workflow and reporting instructions.

ORGAN SELECTION AND RESULTS
• Searchable selection of structures common to the chosen courses.
• Hover list of excluded structures.
• Responsive vertical NTCP chart.
• Interactive results screening with Clear all and Restore all controls.
• Screened organ selections carried through to the HTML report.

HTML REPORTING
• Full report opens in a browser for printing or saving as PDF.
• Yenzakahle logo embedded locally for offline viewing.
• Removed per-course results, recovery sensitivity table and directors footer.
• Compact clinical-goal tables grouped by structure.
• Green results for met goals, red for not met and grey for not evaluable, with a legend and corrected summary counts.
• Expandable goal references and notes.
• Notes, clinical disclaimer, Prepared by and footer kept together on a dedicated final print page.

CLINICAL GOALS
• Fixed bladder and lens maximum-dose checks incorrectly showing Not evaluable.
• Settings shows default goals for structures common to the selected DVHs.
• Inline goal entry: click +, select an OAR and type an objective such as V30Gy<30%.
• Supports maximum dose, mean dose, volume above a dose in percent or cc, and dose at a percentage volume.
• Objective validation with <, <=, > and >= comparisons.
• Local goals can be edited or removed.
• Default goals can be removed and restored without removing organs from NTCP results.
• Goal preferences are saved locally and applied after recalculation.

SETTINGS AND UPDATES
• Optional report/signing folder link configurable per Windows account.
• Separate private Google Drive folder for application downloads.
• Background startup update checks using a public GitHub version file.
• Manual update check, release notes and download-folder button.
• Improved handling of cached GitHub version information.

REPORT SIGNATURES
• Signature window before opening the full report.
• Draw using a mouse or touchscreen, or type a name rendered in cursive.
• Clear, Sign & open report and Skip controls.
• Signature embedded above Prepared by at a print-friendly size.
• Skip leaves the signature area blank; closing the window cancels report opening.
• No reusable signature is saved by the app.

PHONE SIGNING
• Phone tab with a QR code for signing over the same Wi-Fi network.
• Connection status and signature preview on the computer.
• Desktop confirmation before embedding the received signature in the report.
• Temporary signing links expire after 10 minutes and close when the signature window finishes.
• No patient information or report is served to the phone.

LATEST FIXES — VERSION 1.0.14
• Preserved phone signature proportions in the PC preview and HTML report.
• Added support for dots drawn with a single tap.
• PC Clear immediately removes the signature preview and resets the same phone link for a fresh submission, without requiring another QR scan.
• Fixed clear-and-resend behaviour and rejected stale submissions after clearing.
• After sending, the phone shows only the signature-received confirmation. Clearing on the PC restores the drawing controls.

NTCP calculation models remain unchanged. Recalculate and generate a new report to apply updated goals and formatting. Settings and goal preferences are saved locally per Windows account.
